title: Asahi begins moving to the GPL and says its code was taken
summary: Asahi’s progress report says in-development code was lifted from personal forks, and some rewritten with AI to hide its origin. It names nobody.

topics.angle: The foundation everyone builds on changes its terms.
A project that broadly forbids AI-made contributions.

claims.text: Asahi is moving all repositories to GPL v2 or later.
In-development feature code was lifted from personal forks and published without attribution or rewritten with AI assistance.
Asahi broadly forbids generative AI for material contributions.
It’s FOSS raises Aurora and Gravity Linux as context and notes the report names neither.
The report says the MIT licence explicitly allows this and has no protection against bad faith.
Under the GPL, whoever releases a modified version to the public must make its source code available to its users, under the GPL.

to_find: Which code, from the people who say it was taken
would_change: Asahi naming a commit or a project, or a reply that shows the origin of one.
